STEP 1 - Vessel type: square flat plate (white, rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall shadow).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are 20-30 cm; this looks like a medium dinner-size square plate, about 24 cm.
b) Reference: the corn cobs are roughly 4-5 cm wide; across the plate width the plate spans about 5 corn-cob widths plus gaps, which gives roughly 22-25 cm. Cherry tomato (3 cm) is about 1/8 of the plate width, which points to about 24 cm.
Reconciled width: 24 cm, area = 576 cm2.

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Tofu cubes (3 pieces visible, roughly 3 x 3 x 2 cm blocks, plus one sitting partly under greens): footprint about 12% of plate = 69 cm2; thickness about 2 cm (one block, not stacked) → 138 ml x 1.0 = 138 g.
- Zucchini slices (2-3 half-moon slices, about 10 cm2 each, roughly 2 cm thick): footprint about 4% = 23 cm2 x 1.5 cm = 35 ml x 0.6 = 21 g.
- Green beans (about 8 beans, about 12 cm long, thin): footprint about 3% = 17 cm2 x 0.5 cm = 9 ml x 0.6 = 5 g.
- Corn cobs (2 pieces, rounds about 6 cm diameter, 3 cm thick): footprint about 10% = 58 cm2 x 3 cm = 173 ml x 0.7 = 121 g (corn kernels are bulk, use ~0.6 for cooked veg with air gaps: ~104 g; take 110 g).
- Spinach leaves (cooked/wilted, mounded, about 8% of plate): footprint 46 cm2 x 1.5 cm average = 69 ml x 0.6 = 41 g.
- Cherry tomatoes (3 halves/whole, 15 g each, 3 visible): 3 x 15 = 45 g.
- Olive oil/dressing: small amount, about 5 g.

Total about 365 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: tofu and greens are mostly visible; no large hidden base layer. Keep totals as above.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (cooked, as served):
- Tofu (pan-fried): about 150 kcal
- Zucchini (grilled): about 20 kcal
- Green beans (cooked): about 35 kcal
- Corn (cooked): about 96 kcal
- Spinach (cooked): about 23 kcal
- Cherry tomato: about 18 kcal
- Oil/dressing: about 880 kcal
